title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Risk Rule: Tips of an Unfinalized Batch on Debit-Card Cashouts
content:
**Payments Risk rule — Cartwise Shopper Payouts, instant cashouts to an external debit card**

**Rule.** When a shopper cashes out instantly to an external debit card, how much of the tips posted on the shopper's batch that is completed but not yet finalized is held back depends on the shopper's level and tip history:

1. a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Gold level or above with no batch tip reduction in the last 6 months has none of those tips held back;
2. a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Silver level or above with exactly one batch tip reduction in the last 6 months has half of them held back, rounded to the cent;
3. any other shopper has all of them held back.

The tips held back stay on the payout balance and are not sent in the cashout.

**Records the rule reads.**
- *The unfinalized batch and its tips* — from Cartwise Shopper Batches: the shopper's batch whose status is completed but not yet finalized, and the total of the tips posted on that batch.
- *Batch tip reductions* — from Cartwise Shopper Batches: the tip reductions (tips adjusted down) booked on the shopper's batches. "The last 6 months" counts the entries booked fewer than 6 whole months before the day of the cashout.
- *Shopper level* — the level on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" or "or below" is read in that order.

**Decision table.** The three lines of the rule are read in order, and the first that fits governs.

| Shopper level | No tip reduction in the last 6 months | Exactly one in the last 6 months | Two or more in the last 6 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper | all tips held back | all tips held back | all tips held back |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | all tips held back | half held back | all tips held back |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond | none held back | half held back | all tips held back |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**
- A Full-Service Shopper Gold shopper whose only tip reduction was booked 6 whole months and one day before the cashout day has no tip reduction in the last 6 months: none held back. Had it been booked 5 months before the cashout day, it would count as exactly one: half held back.
- A Full-Service Shopper Silver shopper with no tip reduction at all is not on either of the first two lines and has all of the tips held back.
- Hypothetical tips of 23.45 on the unfinalized batch, half held back: half of 23.45 is 11.725, held back as 11.73 after rounding to the cent.

Where the shopper has no batch that is completed but not yet finalized, there are no such tips and nothing is held back under this rule.
